title: 第23章 李大牛拼了第24章 差点把持不住
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大牛对上次的事情一直耿耿于怀，看到李大炮从李大柱家里出来，立即拦住了他。
“大牛，有什么事找我帮忙吗？”
李大炮立即问道，周念瑶那里还等着他去送货，必须得抓紧时间。
李大牛突然就想到自己媳妇上次说要找李大炮帮忙，这让他阴沉着脸，立即喝道：“确实有事情找你帮忙，去我家炕上睡一觉。”
“什么？睡一觉？”
李大炮一脸懵逼，这是什么要求。
“走吧，去我炕上睡一觉，到时候我再给你弄点吃的。”李大牛说道。
李大炮不想去，感觉这是个坑，指不定李大牛和李长贵有一样的想法。
他媳妇王桂芬虽然姿色还算过得去，但也只能算是一般般，和叶秋玲，王美琴都不在一个档次。
“还愣着干什么，想不想要吃的了？”
李大牛开口催促，他可不是要找李大炮帮忙，而是想着上次他睡在炕上让他格外的兴奋，因此今天打算再试一次。
昨天他就已经买了小蓝片，可是最后还是没有弄成，总感觉没有了那个兴奋的劲。
最后一拍脑袋，觉得少了李大炮的缘故，所以今天想把他带回家去，让他睡在旁边，这样能够让他更有兴致。
“想，想要吃的。”
李大炮非常无语，以前当傻子的日子还挺快乐的，但现在装傻好像也挺难受的。
他跟着李大牛回了家。
王桂芬正蹲在家门口洗衣服。
“大牛，你把大炮喊过来干什么？”王桂芬问道。
李大牛没有搭理他，而是命令李大炮去房间，到炕上躺着睡觉。
“大牛，你想干什么？”

王桂芬兴奋地把手擦干，难不成李大牛想通了。
“媳妇，我总结了一下原因所在，不是我身体不行了，而是我们在一起这么多年了，日常生活已经没有了往日的激情。”
“上次我就发现，大炮在旁边，能够让我焕发往日的雄风，所以今天我打算再试一试。”
李大牛说道，这就是他的目的，而不是跟李长贵有一样的想法。
王桂芬立即翻了一个白眼，说道：“没有这个金刚钻，就不要揽这个瓷器活。”
“你这娘们，敢看不起我，今天老子跟你拼了。”
李大牛发飙了，冲过去就想扛起王桂芬，结果发现扛不起，只能拽着她拖进房间。
“这算不算违背妇女意愿啊？”
李大炮有一种想溜的冲动，这都什么事，这样也要喊上他吗？
趁着他们没有注意，他悄悄的开溜，不陪他们玩了。
李大牛没有注意到，等完事之后立即点上一根烟，美滋滋的抽上一口。
“大牛，就你这三两下的事，下次别这么磨磨蹭蹭，耽误我洗衣服。。”王桂芬啐道。
“什么叫三两下的本事，这都五分钟了，你知道对于男人来说五分钟是什么概念吗？”李大牛不服气。
“可是你准备工作就做了四分五十秒。”
王桂芬啐道，碰上这样的男人，注定了这辈子没什么幸福可言。
“妈的，你还敢看不起我？”
“来，证明你自己。”
content_en:
Li Daniu had been brooding about what happened last time. When he saw Li Dapao coming out of Li Dazhu's house, he immediately stopped him.
"Daniu, can you ask me for help?"
Li Dapao immediately asked where Zhou Nianyao was still waiting for him to deliver the goods, so he had to hurry up.
Li Daniu suddenly remembered that his wife had said that she wanted to ask Li Dapao for help last time. This made him look gloomy and immediately shouted: "I really need your help with something. Go and sleep on the kang in my house."
"What? Get some sleep?"
Li Dapao was confused as to what the request was.
"Let's go and sleep on my kang. I'll get you some food then." Li Daniu said.
Li Dapao didn't want to go. He felt it was a trap. Maybe Li Daniu and Li Changgui had the same idea.
Although his daughter-in-law Wang Guifen is pretty, she can only be regarded as average, not on the same level as Ye Qiuling and Wang Meiqin.
"What are you still doing? Do you want something to eat?"
Li Daniu urged. He was not asking Li Dapao for help, but he was thinking that sleeping on the kang made him particularly excited last time, so he planned to try again today.
Yesterday he had bought the little blue film, but in the end he still couldn't finish it. He always felt that the excitement was gone.
After patting my head for the last time, I felt that Li Dapao was missing, so I wanted to take him home today and let him sleep next to him, which would make him more interested.
"I want something to eat."
Li Dapao was very speechless. He used to be quite happy when he was a fool, but now it seems quite uncomfortable to act stupid.
He followed Li Daniu back home.
Wang Guifen was squatting in front of her home washing clothes.
"Daniu, why did you call the cannon over?" Wang Guifen asked.
Li Daniu ignored him and ordered Li Dapao to go to the room and lie down on the kang to sleep.
"Daniu, what do you want to do?"
Wang Guifen wiped her hands dry excitedly, maybe Li Daniu had figured it out.
"Daughter-in-law, I have summarized the reason. It is not that I am not in good health, but that we have been together for so many years, and our daily life has lost the passion it used to have."
"Last time I discovered that having a cannon next to me can help me regain my former glory, so I plan to give it another try today."
Li Daniu said that this was his purpose, not that he had the same idea as Li Changgui.
Wang Guifen immediately rolled her eyes and said, "If you don't have this diamond, don't take this porcelain job."
"You bitch, how dare you look down on me, I will fight with you today."
Li Daniu got mad and rushed over to carry Wang Guifen, but found that he couldn't carry her and could only drag her into the room.
“Does this count as going against a woman’s will?”
Li Dapao had the urge to run away. Why should he call him?
While they were not paying attention, he quietly ran away and stopped playing with them.
Li Daniu didn't notice. After he finished, he immediately lit up a cigarette and took a puff of it happily.
"Daniu, just for your little time, don't waste time like this next time and delay my laundry..." Wang Guifen spat.
"What is the ability to do three or two strokes? It's been five minutes. Do you know what five minutes is to a man?" Li Daniu was unconvinced.
"But you only spent four minutes and fifty seconds getting ready."
Wang Guifen spat, if you meet such a man, you are destined to have no happiness in this life.
"Damn it, you still dare to look down on me?"
"Come on, prove yourself."
